description: List the comments of a Google Doc in full detail: author, dates, open/resolved status, the quoted text each comment refers to, every reply in the thread (with who resolved or reopened it) and, optionally, the surrounding paragraph of the document. This is the main tool of this server.

document.description: Google Docs document ID or full URL (https://docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/edit).

format.description: markdown is easier to read; json returns the structured objects.

include_context.description: Fetch the document text and attach the paragraph where each quoted text appears.

include_deleted.description: Also return deleted comments and replies.

max_results.description: Page size. Comments are returned newest first.

page_token.description: Token from a previous call to fetch the next page.

name: list_comments
title: List comments
